    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

# Workflow authoring reference

A workflow structures work across many agents — to be comprehensive (decompose and cover in parallel), to be confident (independent perspectives and adversarial checks before committing), or to take on scale one context can't hold (migrations, audits, broad sweeps). The script is where you encode that structure: what fans out, what verifies, what synthesizes.

When you do call it, the right move is often **hybrid**: scout inline first (list the files, find the channels, scope the diff) to discover the work-list, then call Workflow to pipeline over it. You don't need to know the shape before the *task* — only before the *orchestration step*.

Common single-phase workflows you can chain across turns:
- **Understand** — parallel readers over relevant subsystems → structured map
- **Design** — judge panel of N independent approaches → scored synthesis
- **Review** — dimensions → find → adversarially verify (the review-changes example)
- **Research** — multi-modal sweep → deep-read → synthesize
- **Migrate** — discover sites → transform each (worktree isolation) → verify

For larger work, run several in sequence — read each result before deciding the next phase. You stay in the loop; each workflow is one well-scoped fan-out.

**Ultracode.** When a system-reminder confirms ultracode is on, that opt-in is standing: author and run a workflow for every substantive task by default. The goal is the most exhaustive, correct answer you can produce — token cost is not a constraint. For multi-phase work (understand → design → implement → review), that often means several workflows in sequence — one per phase — so you stay in the loop between them. The quality patterns below (adversarial verify, multi-modal sweep, completeness critic, loop-until-dry) are the tools; pick what fits the task. Lean toward orchestrating with workflows and adversarially verifying your findings — unless the work is trivial or already verified. Solo only on conversational turns or trivial mechanical edits. When a reminder says ultracode is off, revert to the opt-in rule in the Workflow tool description.

Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first. Every invocation automatically persists its script to a file under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate on a workflow, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with `{scriptPath: "<path>"}` instead of resending the full script.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'find-flaky-tests',
    description: 'Find flaky tests and propose fixes',   // one-line, shown in permission dialog
    phases: [                                            // one entry per phase() call
      { title: 'Scan', detail: 'grep test logs for retries' },
      { title: 'Fix', detail: 'one agent per flaky test' },
    ],
  }
  // script body starts here — use agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase()/log()
  phase('Scan')
  const flaky = await agent('grep CI logs for retry markers', {schema: FLAKY_SCHEMA})
  ...

The `meta` object must be a PURE LITERAL — no variables, function calls, spreads, or template interpolation. Required fields: `name`, `description`. Optional: `whenToUse` (shown in the workflow list), `phases`. Use the SAME phase titles in meta.phases as in phase() calls — titles are matched exactly; a phase() call with no matching meta entry just gets its own progress group.

Script body hooks:
- agent(prompt: string, opts?: {label?: string, phase?: string, schema?: object, effort?: string, isolation?: 'worktree', agentType?: string}): Promise<any> — spawn a subagent. Without schema, returns its final text as a string. With schema (a JSON Schema), the subagent is forced to call a StructuredOutput tool and agent() returns the validated object — no parsing needed. Returns null if the user skips the agent mid-run or the subagent dies on a terminal API error after retries (filter with .filter(Boolean)). opts.label overrides the display label. opts.phase explicitly assigns this agent to a progress group (use this inside pipeline()/parallel() stages to avoid races on the global phase() state — same phase string → same group box). opts.effort overrides the reasoning effort for this agent call ('low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'xhigh' | 'max') — omit to inherit the session effort; use 'low' for cheap mechanical stages and higher tiers only for the hardest verify/judge stages. opts.isolation: 'worktree' runs the agent in a fresh git worktree — EXPENSIVE (~200-500ms setup + disk per agent), use ONLY when agents mutate files in parallel and would otherwise conflict; the worktree is auto-removed if unchanged. opts.agentType uses a custom subagent type (e.g. 'general-purpose', 'code-reviewer') instead of the default workflow subagent — resolved from the same registry as the Agent tool; composes with schema (the custom agent's system prompt gets a StructuredOutput instruction appended).
- pipeline(items, stage1, stage2, ...): Promise<any[]> — run each item through all stages independently, NO barrier between stages. Item A can be in stage 3 while item B is still in stage 1. This is the DEFAULT for multi-stage work. Wall-clock = slowest single-item chain, not sum-of-slowest-per-stage. Every stage callback receives (prevResult, originalItem, index) — use originalItem/index in later stages to label work without threading context through stage 1's return value. A stage that throws drops that item to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- parallel(thunks: Array<() => Promise<any>>): Promise<any[]> — run tasks concurrently. This is a BARRIER: awaits all thunks before returning. A thunk that throws (or whose agent errors) resolves to `null` in the result array — the call itself never rejects, so `.filter(Boolean)` before using the results. Use ONLY when you genuinely need all results together.
- log(message: string): void — emit a progress message to the user (shown as a narrator line above the progress tree)
- phase(title: string): void — start a new phase; subsequent agent() calls are grouped under this title in the progress display
- args: any — the value passed as Workflow's `args` input, verbatim (undefined if not provided). Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values in the tool call, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — `args: ["a.ts", "b.ts"]`, not `args: "[\"a.ts\", ...]"` (a stringified list reaches the script as one string, so `args.filter`/`args.map` throw). Use this to parameterize named workflows — e.g. pass a research question, target path, or config object directly instead of via a side-channel file.
- budget: {total: number|null, spent(): number, remaining(): number} — the turn's token target from the user's "+500k"-style directive. `budget.total` is null if no target was set. `budget.spent()` returns output tokens spent this turn across the main loop and all workflows — the pool is shared, not per-workflow. `budget.remaining()` returns `max(0, total - spent())`, or `Infinity` if no target. The target is a HARD ceiling, not advisory: once `spent()` reaches `total`, further `agent()` calls throw. Use for dynamic loops: `while (budget.total && budget.remaining() > 50_000) { ... }`, or static scaling: `const FLEET = budget.total ? Math.floor(budget.total / 100_000) : 5`.
- workflow(nameOrRef: string | {scriptPath: string}, args?: any): Promise<any> — run another workflow inline as a sub-step and return whatever it returns. Pass a name to invoke a saved workflow (same registry as {name: "..."}), or {scriptPath} to run a script file you Wrote earlier. The child shares this run's concurrency cap, agent counter, abort signal, and token budget — its agents appear under a "▸ name" group in /workflows and its tokens count toward budget.spent(). The args param becomes the child's `args` global. Nesting is one level only: workflow() inside a child throws. Throws on unknown name / unreadable scriptPath / child syntax error; catch to handle gracefully.

Subagents are told their final text IS the return value (not a human-facing message), so they return raw data. For structured output, use the schema option — validation happens at the tool-call layer so the model retries on mismatch.
Schemas need {type: 'object', properties: {...}} at root and required ⊆ properties; unsatisfiable ones throw at agent().

Workflow agents can reach all session-connected MCP tools via ToolSearch — schemas load on demand per agent. Caveat: interactively-authenticated MCP servers (e.g. claude.ai) may be absent in headless/cron runs.

Subagents get the same CLAUDE.md files injected at start that you did (except built-in agent types that omit them, such as Explore and Plan) — don't tell them to re-read those or paste their rules into the prompt; name the specific rule a stage needs, if any.

Scripts are plain JavaScript, NOT TypeScript — type annotations (`: string[]`), interfaces, and generics fail to parse. The script body runs in an async context — use await directly. Standard JS built-ins (JSON, Math, Array, etc.) are available — EXCEPT `Date.now()`/`Math.random()`/argless `new Date()`, which throw (they would break resume); pass timestamps in via `args`, stamp results after the workflow returns, and for randomness vary the agent prompt/label by index. No filesystem or Node.js API access.

DEFAULT TO pipeline(). Only reach for a barrier (parallel between stages) when you genuinely need ALL prior-stage results together.

A barrier is correct ONLY when stage N needs cross-item context from all of stage N-1:
- Dedup/merge across the full result set before expensive downstream work
- Early-exit if the total count is zero ("0 bugs found → skip verification entirely")
- Stage N's prompt references "the other findings" for comparison

A barrier is NOT justified by:
- "I need to flatten/map/filter first" — do it inside a pipeline stage: pipeline(items, stageA, r => transform([r]).flat(), stageB)
- "The stages are conceptually separate" — that's what pipeline() models. Separate stages ≠ synchronized stages.
- "It's cleaner code" — barrier latency is real. If 5 finders run and the slowest takes 3× the fastest, a barrier wastes 2/3 of the fast finders' idle time.

Smell test: if you wrote
  const a = await parallel(...)
  const b = transform(a)        // flatten, map, filter — no cross-item dependency
  const c = await parallel(b.map(...))
that middle transform doesn't need the barrier. Rewrite as a pipeline with the transform inside a stage. When in doubt: pipeline.

Concurrent agent() calls are capped at min(16, available CPUs - 2) per workflow — excess calls queue and run as slots free up. You can still pass 100 items to parallel()/pipeline() and they all complete; only ~10 run at any moment. Total agent count across a workflow's lifetime is capped at 1000 — a runaway-loop backstop set far above any real workflow. A single parallel()/pipeline() call accepts at most 4096 items; passing more is an explicit error, not a silent truncation.

When a barrier IS correct — dedup across all findings before expensive verification:
  const all = await parallel(DIMENSIONS.map(d => () => agent(d.prompt, {schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA})))
  const deduped = dedupeByFileAndLine(all.filter(Boolean).flatMap(r => r.findings))  // <-- genuinely needs ALL at once
  const verified = await parallel(deduped.map(f => () => agent(verifyPrompt(f), {schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})))

Loop-until-count pattern — accumulate to a target:
  const bugs = []
  while (bugs.length < 10) {
    const result = await agent("Find bugs in this codebase.", {schema: BUGS_SCHEMA})
    bugs.push(...result.bugs)
    log(`${bugs.length}/10 found`)
  }

Loop-until-budget pattern — scale depth to the user's "+500k" directive. Guard on budget.total: with no target set, remaining() is Infinity and the loop would run straight to the 1000-agent cap.
  const bugs = []
  while (budget.total && budget.remaining() > 50_000) {
    const result = await agent("Find bugs in this codebase.", {schema: BUGS_SCHEMA})
    bugs.push(...result.bugs)
    log(`${bugs.length} found, ${Math.round(budget.remaining()/1000)}k remaining`)
  }

Composing patterns — exhaustive review (find → dedup vs seen → diverse-lens panel → loop-until-dry):
  const seen = new Set(), confirmed = []
  let dry = 0
  while (dry < 2) {                                              // loop-until-dry
    const found = (await parallel(FINDERS.map(f => () =>          // barrier: collect all finders this round
      agent(f.prompt, {phase: 'Find', schema: BUGS})))).filter(Boolean).flatMap(r => r.bugs)
    const fresh = found.filter(b => !seen.has(key(b)))           // dedup vs ALL seen — plain code, not an agent
    if (!fresh.length) { dry++; continue }
    dry = 0; fresh.forEach(b => seen.add(key(b)))
    const judged = await parallel(fresh.map(b => () =>           // every fresh bug judged concurrently...
      parallel(['correctness','security','repro'].map(lens => () =>   // ...each by 3 distinct lenses
        agent(`Judge "${b.desc}" via the ${lens} lens — real?`, {phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT})))
        .then(vs => ({ b, real: vs.filter(Boolean).filter(v => v.real).length >= 2 }))))
    confirmed.push(...judged.filter(v => v.real).map(v => v.b))
  }
  return confirmed
  // dedup vs `seen`, NOT `confirmed` — else judge-rejected findings reappear every round and it never converges.

Quality patterns — common shapes; pick by task and compose freely:
- Adversarial verify: spawn N independent skeptics per finding, each prompted to REFUTE. Kill if ≥majority refute. Prevents plausible-but-wrong findings from surviving.
    const votes = await parallel(Array.from({length: 3}, () => () =>
      agent(`Try to refute: ${claim}. Default to refuted=true if uncertain.`, {schema: VERDICT})))
    const survives = votes.filter(Boolean).filter(v => !v.refuted).length >= 2
- Perspective-diverse verify: when a finding can fail in more than one way, give each verifier a distinct lens (correctness, security, perf, does-it-reproduce) instead of N identical refuters — diversity catches failure modes redundancy can't.
- Judge panel: generate N independent attempts from different angles (e.g. MVP-first, risk-first, user-first), score with parallel judges, synthesize from the winner while grafting the best ideas from runners-up. Beats one-attempt-iterated when the solution space is wide.
- Loop-until-dry: for unknown-size discovery (bugs, issues, edge cases), keep spawning finders until K consecutive rounds return nothing new. Simple counters (while count < N) miss the tail.
- Multi-modal sweep: parallel agents each searching a different way (by-container, by-content, by-entity, by-time). Each is blind to what the others surface; useful when one search angle won't find everything.
- Completeness critic: a final agent that asks "what's missing — modality not run, claim unverified, source unread?" What it finds becomes the next round of work.
- No silent caps: if a workflow bounds coverage (top-N, no-retry, sampling), `log()` what was dropped — silent truncation reads as "covered everything" when it didn't.

Scale to what the user asked for. "find any bugs" → a few finders, single-vote verify. "thoroughly audit this" or "be comprehensive" → larger finder pool, 3–5 vote adversarial pass, synthesis stage. When unsure, lean toward thoroughness for research/review/audit requests and toward brevity for quick checks.

These patterns aren't exhaustive — compose novel harnesses when the task calls for it (tournament brackets, self-repair loops, staged escalation, whatever fits).

Use this tool for multi-step orchestration where control flow should be deterministic (loops, conditionals, fan-out) rather than model-driven.

## Resume

The tool result includes a runId. To resume after a pause, kill, or script edit, relaunch with Workflow({scriptPath, resumeFromRunId}) — the longest unchanged prefix of agent() calls returns cached results instantly; the first edited/new call and everything after it runs live. Same script + same args → 100% cache hit. Before diagnosing why a completed workflow returned an empty or unexpected result, Read <transcriptDir>/journal.jsonl — it records each agent's actual return value; do not assume cached results are non-empty. Date.now()/Math.random()/new Date() are unavailable in scripts (they would break this) — stamp results after the workflow returns, or pass timestamps via args. Fallback when no journal is available: Read agent-<id>.jsonl files in the transcript directory and hand-author a continuation script.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

1	// Package contractsentinel implements audit rule evaluation over contract artifacts.
2	package contractsentinel
3	
4	import "sort"
5	
6	// Artifact is one compiled contract target under audit.
7	type Artifact struct {
8		Name     string
9		ABI      string
10		Bytecode string
11		Source   string
12	}
13	
14	// Finding is one rule violation with the invariant it breaks.
15	type Finding struct {
16		Rule      string
17		Severity  string
18		Invariant string
19		Evidence  string
20	}
21	
22	// Rule is a static or symbolic check the pipeline can run.
23	type Rule struct {
24		ID          string
25		Kind        string
26		Severity    string
27		Invariant   string
28		RequiresABI bool
29		Version     string
30	}
31	
32	// invariantVerdict is the conclusion the submitted invariant booleans give
33	// one rule. Only a boolean carried under the rule's own invariant name
34	// counts, and only false is a defect: true and absent are distinct
35	// conclusions (the report path records them as 通过 and 未检查), and neither
36	// produces a finding.
37	type invariantVerdict int
38	
39	const (
40		invariantUnchecked invariantVerdict = iota // no value provided for the rule's invariant
41		invariantHolds                             // the invariant was checked and holds
42		invariantViolated                          // the invariant was checked and does not hold
43	)
44	
45	// checkInvariant is the single interpretation of invariant booleans shared by
46	// the finding-list and the report paths, so the judgement rules live in one
47	// place. Invariant names are user-defined: they are looked up exactly as the
48	// rule carries them, case and whitespace included.
49	func checkInvariant(rule Rule, invariants map[string]bool) invariantVerdict {
50		holds, checked := invariants[rule.Invariant]
51		switch {
52		case !checked:
53			return invariantUnchecked
54		case holds:
55			return invariantHolds
56		default:
57			return invariantViolated
58		}
59	}
60	
61	// invariantEvidence is the defect evidence for a violated invariant. The name
62	// is the rule's original value: case, whitespace and punctuation are kept as
63	// written.
64	func invariantEvidence(invariant string) string {
65		return "invariant " + invariant + " does not hold"
66	}
67	
68	// Run executes the deterministic subset of rules and refuses inputs they need.
69	func Run(artifact Artifact, rules []Rule, invariants map[string]bool) ([]Finding, error) {
70		if artifact.Name == "" {
71			return nil, errInvalid("artifact name is required")
72		}
73		var findings []Finding
74		for _, rule := range rules {
75			if rule.RequiresABI && artifact.ABI == "" {
76				return nil, errInvalid("rule " + rule.ID + " needs an ABI")
77			}
78			if rule.Kind == "symbolic" && artifact.Bytecode == "" {
79				return nil, errInvalid("symbolic rule " + rule.ID + " needs bytecode")
80			}
81			if checkInvariant(rule, invariants) == invariantViolated {
82				findings = append(findings, Finding{Rule: rule.ID, Severity: rule.Severity,
83					Invariant: rule.Invariant, Evidence: invariantEvidence(rule.Invariant)})
84			}
85		}
86		sort.Slice(findings, func(i, j int) bool {
87			if findings[i].Severity == findings[j].Severity {
88				return findings[i].Rule < findings[j].Rule
89			}
90			return findings[i].Severity > findings[j].Severity
91		})
92		return findings, nil
93	}
94	
95	type errInvalid string
96	
97	func (e errInvalid) Error() string { return string(e) }

1	# 智能合约审计与形式化验证流水线
2	
3	## 用途
4	
5	合约产物与 ABI 管理、静态规则与模式库、符号执行与模糊测试编排、不变式检查、缺陷归因与报告版本化。
6	
7	本仓库是可持续演进的自托管 Go 应用。领域核心位于 `contractsentinel/`，命令入口位于 `cmd/contractsentinel/`。
8	
9	```bash
10	go run ./cmd/contractsentinel demo
11	go run ./cmd/contractsentinel version
12	go test ./...
13	```
14	
15	## 技术方向
16	
17	smart-contract-audit, formal-verification, symbolic-execution, fuzzing, security, exploit-analysis, reentrancy
18	
19	## 运行要求
20	
21	Go 1.26，仅使用标准库，全部行为可在本机 CPU 上离线复现。
22	
23	## 导入外部检查器的逐规则结论
24	
25	除了 `demo` 与 `version`，`audit` 命令还接受一条 **audit 提交**（一个 JSON 文件），把外部检查器**已经给出的**逐规则结论导入流水线并落盘成报告，随后可用 `report` 命令按报告标识读回。
26	
27	请注意这条功能的边界：
28	
29	- 提交内容是检查器**已经得出的结论**。`audit` 只做绑定校验、归因和报告版本化，**提交本身不会启动符号执行，也不会启动模糊测试**；工具缺失、超时等现场情况由提交者如实记录。
30	- 每条结论必须绑定**产物哈希**与**带版本的规则**，发现（finding）不可事后改写。
31	- 命令完全离线运行：`./cs audit ...` 与 `go run ./cmd/contractsentinel audit ...` 等价，报告写入 `--store` 指定的报告目录，文件名为 `<reportId>.json`。
32	
33	### 提交 JSON 的结构
34	
35	- `artifact`：合约产物，含 `name`、`abi`、`bytecode`、`source` 四个字符串字段。字段可以省略（省略时按空字符串处理），但**一旦写出，值就必须是 JSON 字符串**：写成 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组都会使整份提交失败，而不会被当成空字符串继续——见下文“产物字段不是字符串”。
36	- `rules`：本次适用的规则数组，每条规则必须有非空 `id` 与 `version`，`id` 在数组内唯一；`requiresABI` 为真时产物必须有非空 `abi`，`kind` 为 `symbolic` 时产物必须有非空 `bytecode`。`requiresABI` 可以省略（按 `false` 处理），但一旦写出就必须是 JSON 布尔值 `true` 或 `false`：`null`、字符串、数字、对象或数组都会使整份提交失败，而不会被当成 `false` 继续。规则的 `id`、`kind`、`severity`、`invariant`、`version` 五个文本成员同理：可以省略（省略时按空字符串并走既有必填/业务校验），但**一旦写出，值就必须是 JSON 字符串**，写成 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组都会使整份提交失败，而不会被当成空字符串继续——见下文“规则定义的文本成员不是字符串”。
37	- `invariants`：不变式名到 JSON 布尔值的映射（既有用法，见文末）。
38	- `checks`：外部检查器给出的逐规则记录数组，每条记录含：
39	  - `artifactHash`：该结论所针对产物的哈希，必须与本次 `artifact` 实际算出的哈希一致；
40	  - `ruleId` / `version`：必须分别对应 `rules` 中已有的规则标识及其版本；
41	  - `status`：可导入的结论只有四种 —— `通过`、`发现缺陷`、`工具缺失`、`超时`；
42	  - `note`：检查器的原始说明。
43	
44	结论与说明的规则：
45	
46	- **`通过`** 可以没有说明（整个 `note` 字段可省略）。
47	- **`发现缺陷`、`工具缺失`、`超时`** 三种状态都必须带**非空白**说明；只有空格或换行的说明会使整份提交失败。
48	- **`超时` 同样属于检查未得到正常结论**，不是缺陷：它保留在规则结果里并必须附带截止时间等说明，但不会进入 `findings`。
49	- **`未检查` 不是可导入的结论**：把记录的 `status` 写成 `未检查` 会被当作未知状态拒绝。一条规则既没有 checks 记录、也没有不变式布尔值时，报告里才自然呈现 `未检查`。
50	- 只有 **`发现缺陷`** 记录进入报告的 `findings`；`工具缺失` 与 `超时` 只保留在规则结果中，绝不虚报成缺陷。
51	- 缺陷 finding 的证据（`evidence`）逐字采用该记录的原始 `note`（不修剪空格、不套模板改写）；原始 note 不会被改写成其他缺陷证据。

210	### 读回失败条件（归档损坏，非零退出，不动归档）
211	
212	`report` 读取时报告标识必须是**恰好 64 位小写十六进制字符串**，且归档字节必须完整合法。下列情况命令都以**非零状态退出**，原因写入 **stderr**，stdout 不出现任何报告片段（不会输出部分规则或部分字段），原归档保持原样（不删除、不自动修补、不留临时文件）：
213	
214	- 标识格式不合法（`invalid report id …`）；
215	- 目录中没有该标识的归档，或报告目录本身不存在（`report … not found`）；
216	- 归档损坏或内容与标识不符：JSON 语法错误、任何对象重复成员名、成员名称或字符串值含非法 UTF-8 / 错误代理转义、`reportId` 与重算内容不符、规则与缺陷的一一绑定被破坏等；
217	- **规则的 `requiresABI` 不是布尔值。** 正式 `requiresABI` 成员（约定拼写，含 Unicode 转义写法）一旦在归档中出现，值必须是 `true` 或 `false`；写成 `null`、字符串、数字、对象或数组时**整份归档判为损坏**。`null` 在解码时会被静默当成 Go 零值 `false`：即使把归档里原本的 `false` 换成 `null` 后，报告标识、规则状态与缺陷绑定仍能全部吻合，读出的规则定义也显示 `false`，但这掩盖了归档内容不合法的事实，因此照样拒绝。这条规则适用于报告中的**每条规则**，与该规则是否已经检查、是否发现缺陷无关；一条规则不合法时不会只跳过它返回其余规则。错误会点名报告标识与出错规则：
218	
219	  ```text
220	  report failed: report a6fa091b…3b34 archive is corrupt: rule reentrancy-guard: requiresABI must be a boolean
221	  ```
222	
223	  省略该成员仍按 `false` 读回；合法 `true` / `false` 按原值读回，报告标识、规则状态与原始证据不变。`RequiresABI`、`" requiresABI "` 这类大小写变体或带空格的名称仍只作为扩展信息忽略，其中的 `null` 不导致本错误，也不能替代正式成员；正式成员非法时，旁边的变体即使写了合法布尔值（无论位于它之前还是之后）都不能使读取成功。
224	
225	- **规则的文本成员不是字符串。** 每条规则已写出的正式 `id`、`kind`、`severity`、`invariant`、`version`、`status`、`note` 成员（约定拼写，含 Unicode 转义写法），值必须是 JSON 字符串；写成 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组时**整份归档判为损坏**。`null` 在解码时会被静默当成 Go 零值 `""`：给一条没有说明的“通过”规则加入 `"note":null`，报告标识、规则状态与缺陷绑定仍能全部吻合，读出的说明也是空字符串，但归档并没有按格式保存文本，因此照样拒绝。这条规则适用于报告中的**每条规则**与所有检查状态，也适用于没有任何 finding 的报告；一条规则不合法时不会只跳过它返回其余规则。错误会点名报告标识、出错字段与规则在 `rules` 数组中的位置，规则有合法非空 `id` 时同时点名该规则：
226	
227	  ```text
228	  report failed: report a6fa091b…3b34 archive is corrupt: rules[1] (rule owner-only-withdraw): note must be a string
229	  ```
230	
231	  省略成员仍沿用既有默认值与必填校验，显式空字符串仍按既有业务规则判断（例如空 `version` 仍报 `has an empty version`），不会一律要求所有文本非空；通过或未检查的规则可以没有说明。`Note`、`" note "` 这类大小写变体或带空格的名称仍只作为扩展信息忽略，其中的 `null` 不导致本错误，也不能替代或挽救非法的正式成员。合法报告读回后的标识、结论、说明与缺陷证据保持原值，中文、换行和前后空格不被修剪或改写。
232	
233	### 提交失败条件（整份失败，不产生部分报告）
234	
235	下列情况都会使**整份提交**被拒绝：命令以**非零状态退出**，原因写入**标准错误（stderr）**，stdout 没有任何报告片段，报告目录中**不会**出现成功报告（目录原本不存在时也不会被创建）。
236	
237	1. **checks 记录的产物哈希不匹配。** 任一条记录的 `artifactHash` 不等于本次产物实际哈希即失败，即使其余记录都合法。例如把 `solvency-symbolic` 记录的哈希改成另一个 64 位十六进制串：
238	
239	   ```text
240	   audit failed: check for rule solvency-symbolic: artifact hash mismatch
241	   ```
242	
243	2. **checks 记录的规则版本不匹配。** 记录的 `version` 必须等于 `rules` 中该规则的版本；声称针对旧版本即失败：
244	
245	   ```text
246	   audit failed: check for rule reentrancy-guard: version mismatch
247	   ```
248	
249	3. **同一条规则既收到 checks 记录，又在 `invariants` 中收到它所引用的不变式布尔值。** 例如对 `reentrancy-guard` 既给 checks 记录、又给 `"invariants": {"no-reentrant-withdraw": false}`。这是冲突输入，会**整份失败**，不会被解释成“在两种结果之间自动选一个”：
250	
251	   ```text
252	   audit failed: rule reentrancy-guard: both a check record and an invariant value are provided
253	   ```
254	
255	4. **提交内容含非法字符。** 出于正确性，程序**不会**删除或替换坏字符后继续处理：
256	
257	   - JSON 字符串（成员名称或任何字符串值，即使只出现在不参与报告的未知扩展成员及其嵌套内容里）含有**非法 UTF-8 字节**；
258	   - JSON 的 `\uXXXX` Unicode 转义里出现**未配对的高/低代理项**，或**配对顺序错误**（低代理项在前）。
259	
260	   否则这两类字节都会被解码器静默改写成 U+FFFD：缺陷 `note` 的证据会变成与提交原文不符的文字，`source` 等字段被改写还会改变参与产物哈希计算的内容。命中时整份拒绝，stderr 说明是字符编码还是 Unicode 转义问题并给出字节偏移、行列与 JSON 路径，方便修正原始内容：
261	
262	   ```text
263	   audit failed: invalid Unicode escape: unpaired high surrogate escape \uD800 in JSON string value at .checks[0].note (byte offset 535, line 24, column 19)
264	   audit failed: invalid character encoding: invalid UTF-8 byte 0xff in JSON string value at .artifact.source (byte offset 135, line 6, column 31)
265	   ```
266	
267	   合法字符不受影响：中文、换行、前后空格、正确成对的代理转义（如 `😀`）与直接书写的同一字符都可使用，`note`/证据保留解码后的原文，两种写法的产物哈希与报告标识一致；原文中本就存在的 U+FFFD 只是普通字符，`"\\uD800"`（转义反斜线后跟 `uD800`）也只是普通文本，不会被误判。
268	
269	5. **规则的 `requiresABI` 不是布尔值。** 正式 `requiresABI` 成员（约定拼写，含 Unicode 转义写法）一旦写出，值必须是 `true` 或 `false`；写成 `null`、字符串、数字、对象或数组时整份失败，不会被当成 `false` 继续，即使产物已有 ABI、规则没有收到任何检查结论也一样。错误会点名出错的规则：
270	
271	   ```text
272	   audit failed: rule reentrancy-guard: requiresABI must be a boolean
273	   ```
274	
275	   省略该成员仍按 `false` 处理；`RequiresABI`、`" requiresABI "` 这类大小写变体或带空格的名称只是扩展信息，其中的 `null` 不触发本错误，也不能替代或挽救正式成员的非法值。
276	
277	6. **产物字段不是字符串。** 正式 `name`、`abi`、`bytecode`、`source` 成员（约定拼写，含 Unicode 转义写法）一旦在 `artifact` 中写出，值必须是 JSON 字符串；写成 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组时**整份失败**。`null` 在解码时会被静默当成 Go 零值 `""`：产物名称合法、规则数组为空、`source` 写成 `null` 这样的提交会与用户明确提交 `"source": ""` 算出**相同的产物哈希**并照常拿到成功报告，格式错误的内容因此与合法空文本混在一起，无法区分，所以照样拒绝。这条检查只看 JSON 类型，与有没有规则、有没有 checks 记录、规则是否引用该字段无关——没有规则、没有检查记录时也一样执行；它属于**提交格式错误**，不会被记成缺陷、工具缺失或超时。错误会点名具体字段：
278	
279	   ```text
280	   audit failed: artifact.source must be a string
281	   ```
282	
283	   省略成员仍沿用既有默认值（按空字符串处理），显式空字符串也保留原来的业务判断：缺少或为空的名称仍不能生成报告（`artifact name is required`），`requiresABI` 为真的规则仍要求非空 `abi`，符号规则仍要求非空 `bytecode`；没有这些要求时，合法空文本可以正常使用，且省略与显式 `""` 的产物哈希、报告标识一致。`Name`、`" source "` 这类大小写变体或带空格的名称仍只作为扩展信息忽略，其中的任何值都不能补上缺失的正式字段，也不能挽救正式字段的非法值（无论位于其前还是其后）。合法字符串逐字保留中文、换行与前后空格，`source` 始终是提交的文本内容，不按文件名读取；合法提交的产物哈希、报告标识、规则结论与缺陷证据保持原有结果。
284	
285	7. **规则定义的文本成员不是字符串。** `rules` 中每条规则已写出的正式 `id`、`kind`、`severity`、`invariant`、`version` 成员（约定拼写，含 Unicode 转义写法），值必须是 JSON 字符串；写成 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组时**整份失败**。`null` 在解码时会被静默当成 Go 零值 `""`：一条 `id` 与 `version` 合法的规则即使把 `kind`、`severity` 或 `invariant` 写成 `null`，也可能通过全部业务检查并生成报告，空掉的定义与用户明确提交空字符串得到的规则定义、报告标识和缺陷绑定完全相同，格式错误因此被洗成了合法提交，所以照样拒绝。这条检查适用于 `rules` 中的**每条规则**，与该规则是否被检查、是否产生缺陷无关；其他规则与 checks 记录合法也不能使提交成功。它属于**规则定义的提交格式错误**，不会被记成缺陷、工具缺失或超时。错误会点名规则在 `rules` 数组中从零开始的位置与出错字段；规则有合法非空 `id` 时同时点名，`id` 自身非法时仍可凭位置定位：
286	
287	   ```text
288	   audit failed: rules[1] (rule owner-only-withdraw): severity must be a string
289	   ```
290	
291	   省略成员仍沿用既有默认值与必填校验（省略或为空的 `id` 仍报 `rule id is required`，空 `version` 仍报 `version is required`），显式空字符串仍按既有业务规则判断，不会一律要求五个文本非空或限制取值范围；省略与显式 `""` 的报告标识一致。`Kind`、`" invariant "` 这类大小写变体或带空格的名称及未知成员仍只作为扩展信息忽略，其中的 `null` 不触发本错误，合法字符串也不能补上缺失字段或挽救非法正式字段（无论位于其前还是其后）。合法字符串逐字保留中文、换行与前后空格；已有合法提交的产物哈希、报告标识、规则结论与缺陷证据保持原有结果。失败时尚不存在的报告目录不被创建，已有归档保持原样。
292	
293	此外，记录引用了 `rules` 中不存在的规则、同一规则出现多条 checks 记录、`status` 写成 `未检查` 等未知值（`unknown status …`）、或三种需要说明的状态给了空白说明（`note is required for status …`），同样整份拒绝。

295	## 比较两份已保存的报告（diff）
296	
297	`diff` 从**同一个报告目录**中读取两份已经落盘的报告，逐规则比较并输出确定性的比较 JSON（无时间戳，重复比较同一对报告结果逐字节一致）。
298	
299	```bash
300	go run ./cmd/contractsentinel diff \
301	  --store ./reports \
302	  --before <基准报告 reportId> \
303	  --after <新报告 reportId>
304	```
305	
306	`./cs diff ...` 与上面的 `go run ./cmd/contractsentinel diff ...` 等价，全程离线。
307	
308	三个参数各选什么：
309	
310	- **`--store`**：两份报告共同所在的报告目录，与 `audit`、`report` 用的是同一个目录参数。
311	- **`--before`**：基准报告（当作对照的较早一次审计）；**`--after`**：新报告。
312	- **比较方向只由两个标识所在的参数位置决定**：工具不按文件时间或归档顺序猜测方向。交换两个参数，所有“新发现/已消除”的方向随之反转。
313	- 两个参数填的都必须是各自 **`audit` 成功输出（stdout）里的 `reportId`**（随后也可用 `report` 读回确认），**不是产物哈希**。产物哈希相同只说明两份报告审计的产物内容相同，不能拿它当报告标识。
314	- `diff` 只**读取已保存的结论**做比较：不会重新检查合约，不启动符号执行或模糊测试，不重新解释证据，也不写入或修改报告目录。

491	### 比较结果的分类与字段
492	
493	每个在任一侧出现过的规则标识恰好产生一个 `results` 条目，按 `ruleId` 排序；该侧没有这条规则时对应一侧为 `null`。`change` 沿用既有八类：
494	
495	| change | 含义 |
496	| --- | --- |
497	| `新发现缺陷` | 定义完全一致，且状态 `通过 → 发现缺陷` |
498	| `已消除缺陷` | 定义完全一致，且状态 `发现缺陷 → 通过` |
499	| `检查状态变化` | 定义一致，但状态迁移不属于上面两种（涉及 `超时`、`工具缺失`、`未检查` 等） |
500	| `检查说明变化` | 状态相同，仅 note 不同 |
501	| `无变化` | 状态与说明都相同 |
502	| `新增规则` / `移除规则` | 规则标识只在新侧 / 基准侧出现 |
503	| `规则变化` | 同名规则的版本或其他定义字段不同，不比较检查状态 |
504	
505	`before` / `after` 两侧的 `rule` 是该侧完整规则（含 `version`、`status`、`note`）；`finding` 仅在该侧该规则为 `发现缺陷` 时出现，携带当侧归档的 `artifactHash`、`version` 与逐字证据。顶层 `artifactNameChanged` / `artifactHashChanged` 标明两侧产物是否同名同内容。`summary` 中八类计数与逐条 `change` 一一对应且零值也总是出现，`beforeDefects` / `afterDefects` 是两侧缺陷总数。

507	### diff 失败条件（非零退出，无部分结果，不动归档）
508	
509	报告标识必须是**恰好 64 位小写十六进制字符串**。下列情况命令都以**非零状态退出**，原因写入 **stderr**，stdout 没有任何比较片段（即使第一份报告已成功读取也不会输出部分结果），报告目录与已有归档保持原样（不创建目录、不修复或改写损坏文件、不留临时文件）：
510	
511	- 标识格式不合法：
512	
513	  ```text
514	  diff failed: invalid report id xyz: want 64 lowercase hex characters
515	  ```
516	
517	- 任一报告在目录中不存在（含报告目录本身不存在）：
518	
519	  ```text
520	  diff failed: report 0000…0000 not found
521	  ```
522	
523	- 任一归档损坏或内容与标识不符：
524	
525	  ```text
526	  diff failed: invalid JSON in report 738004a6…0e4e0: invalid character 'b' looking for beginning of object key string
527	  ```
528	
529	- 任一归档的规则定义里，正式 `requiresABI` 成员写成了 `null`、字符串、数字、对象或数组等非布尔值：
530	
531	  ```text
532	  diff failed: report a6fa091b…3b34 archive is corrupt: rule reentrancy-guard: requiresABI must be a boolean
533	  ```
534	
535	  `null` 会被解码静默当成 `false`，损坏归档因此可能与合法归档同标识，甚至被误判为“无变化”；比较前的类型校验会先拒绝整份归档，**任一侧**命中都直接失败，不输出任何比较结果，也不会把被默认成 `false` 的规则拿去判断“规则变化”或“无变化”。省略 `requiresABI` 仍按 `false`，合法 `true` / `false` 的既有比较行为不变。
536	
537	- 任一归档的规则文本成员（正式的 `id`、`kind`、`severity`、`invariant`、`version`、`status`、`note`）写成了 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组等非字符串值：
538	
539	  ```text
540	  diff failed: report a6fa091b…3b34 archive is corrupt: rules[0] (rule owner-only-withdraw): note must be a string
541	  ```
542	
543	  `null` 会被解码静默当成空字符串，损坏归档因此可能与合法归档同标识，甚至被误判为“无变化”；比较前的类型校验会先拒绝整份归档，**任一侧**命中都直接失败，不输出任何比较结果，也不会把被默认成空字符串的内容拿去判断“无变化”。省略成员仍按既有默认值处理，已有合法报告的比较分类与统计保持不变。
544	
545	## 仅提交不变式布尔值（既有用法，保持不变）
546	
547	在 checks 导入能力之前就存在的用法仍然有效：提交只给 `invariants`（不变式名到布尔值的映射）而不给 `checks`。值为 `false` 的不变式使引用它的规则记为 `发现缺陷` 并生成 finding，证据为 `invariant <不变式名> does not hold`；值为 `true` 记为 `通过`；未出现的规则记为 `未检查`。
548	
549	```json
550	{
551	  "artifact": {"name": "Vault", "abi": "[{\"name\":\"withdraw\"}]", "bytecode": "0x6080", "source": "Vault.sol"},
552	  "rules": [
553	    {"id": "reentrancy-guard", "kind": "static", "severity": "high", "invariant": "no-reentrant-withdraw", "requiresABI": false, "version": "1.0.0"}
554	  ],
555	  "invariants": {"no-reentrant-withdraw": false}
556	}
557	```
558	
559	checks 导入的补充**不改变**输入格式、报告内容或现有命令的行为：上述提交的字段、生成的报告与报告标识都与以前一致。
560

# 智能合约审计与形式化验证流水线

## 用途

合约产物与 ABI 管理、静态规则与模式库、符号执行与模糊测试编排、不变式检查、缺陷归因与报告版本化。

本仓库是可持续演进的自托管 Go 应用。领域核心位于 `contractsentinel/`，命令入口位于 `cmd/contractsentinel/`。

```bash
go run ./cmd/contractsentinel demo
go run ./cmd/contractsentinel version
go test ./...
```

## 技术方向

smart-contract-audit, formal-verification, symbolic-execution, fuzzing, security, exploit-analysis, reentrancy

## 运行要求

Go 1.26，仅使用标准库，全部行为可在本机 CPU 上离线复现。

## 导入外部检查器的逐规则结论

除了 `demo` 与 `version`，`audit` 命令还接受一条 **audit 提交**（一个 JSON 文件），把外部检查器**已经给出的**逐规则结论导入流水线并落盘成报告，随后可用 `report` 命令按报告标识读回。

请注意这条功能的边界：

- 提交内容是检查器**已经得出的结论**。`audit` 只做绑定校验、归因和报告版本化，**提交本身不会启动符号执行，也不会启动模糊测试**；工具缺失、超时等现场情况由提交者如实记录。
- 每条结论必须绑定**产物哈希**与**带版本的规则**，发现（finding）不可事后改写。
- 命令完全离线运行：`./cs audit ...` 与 `go run ./cmd/contractsentinel audit ...` 等价，报告写入 `--store` 指定的报告目录，文件名为 `<reportId>.json`。

### 提交 JSON 的结构

- `artifact`：合约产物，含 `name`、`abi`、`bytecode`、`source` 四个字符串字段。字段可以省略（省略时按空字符串处理），但**一旦写出，值就必须是 JSON 字符串**：写成 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组都会使整份提交失败，而不会被当成空字符串继续——见下文“产物字段不是字符串”。
- `rules`：本次适用的规则数组，每条规则必须有非空 `id` 与 `version`，`id` 在数组内唯一；`requiresABI` 为真时产物必须有非空 `abi`，`kind` 为 `symbolic` 时产物必须有非空 `bytecode`。`requiresABI` 可以省略（按 `false` 处理），但一旦写出就必须是 JSON 布尔值 `true` 或 `false`：`null`、字符串、数字、对象或数组都会使整份提交失败，而不会被当成 `false` 继续。规则的 `id`、`kind`、`severity`、`invariant`、`version` 五个文本成员同理：可以省略（省略时按空字符串并走既有必填/业务校验），但**一旦写出，值就必须是 JSON 字符串**，写成 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组都会使整份提交失败，而不会被当成空字符串继续——见下文“规则定义的文本成员不是字符串”。
- `invariants`：不变式名到 JSON 布尔值的映射（既有用法，见文末）。
- `checks`：外部检查器给出的逐规则记录数组，每条记录含：
  - `artifactHash`：该结论所针对产物的哈希，必须与本次 `artifact` 实际算出的哈希一致；
  - `ruleId` / `version`：必须分别对应 `rules` 中已有的规则标识及其版本；
  - `status`：可导入的结论只有四种 —— `通过`、`发现缺陷`、`工具缺失`、`超时`；
  - `note`：检查器的原始说明。

结论与说明的规则：

- **`通过`** 可以没有说明（整个 `note` 字段可省略）。
- **`发现缺陷`、`工具缺失`、`超时`** 三种状态都必须带**非空白**说明；只有空格或换行的说明会使整份提交失败。
- **`超时` 同样属于检查未得到正常结论**，不是缺陷：它保留在规则结果里并必须附带截止时间等说明，但不会进入 `findings`。
- **`未检查` 不是可导入的结论**：把记录的 `status` 写成 `未检查` 会被当作未知状态拒绝。一条规则既没有 checks 记录、也没有不变式布尔值时，报告里才自然呈现 `未检查`。
- 只有 **`发现缺陷`** 记录进入报告的 `findings`；`工具缺失` 与 `超时` 只保留在规则结果中，绝不虚报成缺陷。
- 缺陷 finding 的证据（`evidence`）逐字采用该记录的原始 `note`（不修剪空格、不套模板改写）；原始 note 不会被改写成其他缺陷证据。

### 完整示例输入

把以下内容保存为 `audit-input.json`（`source` 是一个普通字符串值，里面的 `\n` 是 JSON 换行转义）：

```json
{
  "artifact": {
    "name": "Vault",
    "abi": "[{\"name\":\"withdraw\",\"type\":\"function\",\"stateMutability\":\"payable\"}]",
    "bytecode": "0x6080604052",
    "source": "// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.0;\n\ncontract Vault {\n    mapping(address => uint256) private balances;\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 amount) public {\n        (bool sent, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}(\"\");\n        require(sent, \"transfer failed\");\n        balances[msg.sender] -= amount;\n    }\n}\n"
  },
  "rules": [
    {
      "id": "reentrancy-guard",
      "kind": "static",
      "severity": "high",
      "invariant": "no-reentrant-withdraw",
      "requiresABI": false,
      "version": "1.4.2"
    },
    {
      "id": "owner-only-withdraw",
      "kind": "static",
      "severity": "medium",
      "invariant": "withdraw-owner-only",
      "requiresABI": true,
      "version": "2.1.0"
    },
    {
      "id": "solvency-symbolic",
      "kind": "symbolic",
      "severity": "critical",
      "invariant": "balances-cover-withdrawals",
      "requiresABI": false,
      "version": "0.9.3"
    }
  ],
  "invariants": {},
  "checks": [
    {
      "artifactHash": "0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7",
      "ruleId": "reentrancy-guard",
      "version": "1.4.2",
      "status": "发现缺陷",
      "note": "反例：攻击者先存入 1 ether 后调用 withdraw；call 在 balances 扣减前把控制权交给攻击合约的 receive，receive 重入 withdraw，此时 balances[msg.sender] 仍是旧值，同一笔余额被第二次转出。"
    },
    {
      "artifactHash": "0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7",
      "ruleId": "owner-only-withdraw",
      "version": "2.1.0",
      "status": "通过"
    },
    {
      "artifactHash": "0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7",
      "ruleId": "solvency-symbolic",
      "version": "0.9.3",
      "status": "工具缺失",
      "note": "符号执行引擎未安装：PATH 中未找到 mythril，无法求解 balances-cover-withdrawals。"
    }
  ]
}
```

其中的关键绑定值相互对应、可直接使用，不是占位符：

- 三条 checks 记录里的 `artifactHash` 全部是
  `0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7`，
  它正是上面 `abi`、`bytecode`、`source` 三个字符串内容算出的产物哈希。
- 每条记录的 `version` 与同名规则的 `version` 一一对应（`1.4.2` / `2.1.0` / `0.9.3`）。
- `source` 就是**提交的字符串值本身**：即使把它写成一个文件名，程序也**不会**按文件名去磁盘读取本地源码，参与哈希的是字符串里的字符。产物的 `name`（`Vault`）**不参与**哈希计算。

### 提交并生成报告

```bash
mkdir -p reports
go run ./cmd/contractsentinel audit --input audit-input.json --store ./reports
```

在本机离线运行的成功输出（stdout）如下，报告同时落盘为
`./reports/a6fa091bc2bb94a56453b3d58a190ff2c17c7023b7d2fd0600ffccccb3b13b34.json`：

```json
{
  "reportId": "a6fa091bc2bb94a56453b3d58a190ff2c17c7023b7d2fd0600ffccccb3b13b34",
  "artifact": {
    "name": "Vault",
    "hash": "0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7"
  },
  "rules": [
    {
      "id": "reentrancy-guard",
      "kind": "static",
      "severity": "high",
      "invariant": "no-reentrant-withdraw",
      "requiresABI": false,
      "version": "1.4.2",
      "status": "发现缺陷",
      "note": "反例：攻击者先存入 1 ether 后调用 withdraw；call 在 balances 扣减前把控制权交给攻击合约的 receive，receive 重入 withdraw，此时 balances[msg.sender] 仍是旧值，同一笔余额被第二次转出。"
    },
    {
      "id": "owner-only-withdraw",
      "kind": "static",
      "severity": "medium",
      "invariant": "withdraw-owner-only",
      "requiresABI": true,
      "version": "2.1.0",
      "status": "通过"
    },
    {
      "id": "solvency-symbolic",
      "kind": "symbolic",
      "severity": "critical",
      "invariant": "balances-cover-withdrawals",
      "requiresABI": false,
      "version": "0.9.3",
      "status": "工具缺失",
      "note": "符号执行引擎未安装：PATH 中未找到 mythril，无法求解 balances-cover-withdrawals。"
    }
  ],
  "findings": [
    {
      "artifactHash": "0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7",
      "ruleId": "reentrancy-guard",
      "version": "1.4.2",
      "severity": "high",
      "invariant": "no-reentrant-withdraw",
      "evidence": "反例：攻击者先存入 1 ether 后调用 withdraw；call 在 balances 扣减前把控制权交给攻击合约的 receive，receive 重入 withdraw，此时 balances[msg.sender] 仍是旧值，同一笔余额被第二次转出。"
    }
  ]
}
```

请分清输出中的两个标识：

- **`artifact.hash`（artifactHash）** 绑定 ABI、字节码和 source 字符串的**内容**，合约名称不参与。同一份产物内容无论出现在哪份报告里，这个哈希都相同；findings 中的 `artifactHash` 与它一致。
- **`reportId`** 是**整份报告**的内容寻址标识（产物哈希、名称、全部规则定义、每条规则的状态与版本、全部 findings 共同决定）。读回报告时用它，而不是用 artifactHash。

可以看到：`reentrancy-guard` 是带反例说明的唯一 `发现缺陷`，其证据就是提交时的原始 note；`solvency-symbolic` 仍是 `工具缺失`（版本 `0.9.3`，说明保留在规则结果中），不进 `findings`；`owner-only-withdraw` 为 `通过` 且无 note。

### 根据成功输出读回报告

用成功输出里的 `reportId`，从同一个报告目录读取：

```bash
go run ./cmd/contractsentinel report \
  --store ./reports \
  --id a6fa091bc2bb94a56453b3d58a190ff2c17c7023b7d2fd0600ffccccb3b13b34
```

读回的是同一份完整报告 JSON（与提交成功时逐字段相同，不会被重新解释）。其中可以直接核对每条规则的**状态、版本**以及缺陷证据，例如：

- `reentrancy-guard`：`"version": "1.4.2"`、`"status": "发现缺陷"`，note 为反例原文；
- `owner-only-withdraw`：`"version": "2.1.0"`、`"status": "通过"`；
- `solvency-symbolic`：`"version": "0.9.3"`、`"status": "工具缺失"`，note 说明引擎缺失；
- `findings` 中只有一条，归属 `reentrancy-guard` / 版本 `1.4.2` / 产物哈希 `0cdb8997…3a8ca7`，`evidence` 是上面的完整反例说明——而不是仅仅一个缺陷计数。

### 读回失败条件（归档损坏，非零退出，不动归档）

`report` 读取时报告标识必须是**恰好 64 位小写十六进制字符串**，且归档字节必须完整合法。下列情况命令都以**非零状态退出**，原因写入 **stderr**，stdout 不出现任何报告片段（不会输出部分规则或部分字段），原归档保持原样（不删除、不自动修补、不留临时文件）：

- 标识格式不合法（`invalid report id …`）；
- 目录中没有该标识的归档，或报告目录本身不存在（`report … not found`）；
- 归档损坏或内容与标识不符：JSON 语法错误、任何对象重复成员名、成员名称或字符串值含非法 UTF-8 / 错误代理转义、`reportId` 与重算内容不符、规则与缺陷的一一绑定被破坏等；
- **规则的 `requiresABI` 不是布尔值。** 正式 `requiresABI` 成员（约定拼写，含 Unicode 转义写法）一旦在归档中出现，值必须是 `true` 或 `false`；写成 `null`、字符串、数字、对象或数组时**整份归档判为损坏**。`null` 在解码时会被静默当成 Go 零值 `false`：即使把归档里原本的 `false` 换成 `null` 后，报告标识、规则状态与缺陷绑定仍能全部吻合，读出的规则定义也显示 `false`，但这掩盖了归档内容不合法的事实，因此照样拒绝。这条规则适用于报告中的**每条规则**，与该规则是否已经检查、是否发现缺陷无关；一条规则不合法时不会只跳过它返回其余规则。错误会点名报告标识与出错规则：

  ```text
  report failed: report a6fa091b…3b34 archive is corrupt: rule reentrancy-guard: requiresABI must be a boolean
  ```

  省略该成员仍按 `false` 读回；合法 `true` / `false` 按原值读回，报告标识、规则状态与原始证据不变。`RequiresABI`、`" requiresABI "` 这类大小写变体或带空格的名称仍只作为扩展信息忽略，其中的 `null` 不导致本错误，也不能替代正式成员；正式成员非法时，旁边的变体即使写了合法布尔值（无论位于它之前还是之后）都不能使读取成功。

- **规则的文本成员不是字符串。** 每条规则已写出的正式 `id`、`kind`、`severity`、`invariant`、`version`、`status`、`note` 成员（约定拼写，含 Unicode 转义写法），值必须是 JSON 字符串；写成 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组时**整份归档判为损坏**。`null` 在解码时会被静默当成 Go 零值 `""`：给一条没有说明的“通过”规则加入 `"note":null`，报告标识、规则状态与缺陷绑定仍能全部吻合，读出的说明也是空字符串，但归档并没有按格式保存文本，因此照样拒绝。这条规则适用于报告中的**每条规则**与所有检查状态，也适用于没有任何 finding 的报告；一条规则不合法时不会只跳过它返回其余规则。错误会点名报告标识、出错字段与规则在 `rules` 数组中的位置，规则有合法非空 `id` 时同时点名该规则：

  ```text
  report failed: report a6fa091b…3b34 archive is corrupt: rules[1] (rule owner-only-withdraw): note must be a string
  ```

  省略成员仍沿用既有默认值与必填校验，显式空字符串仍按既有业务规则判断（例如空 `version` 仍报 `has an empty version`），不会一律要求所有文本非空；通过或未检查的规则可以没有说明。`Note`、`" note "` 这类大小写变体或带空格的名称仍只作为扩展信息忽略，其中的 `null` 不导致本错误，也不能替代或挽救非法的正式成员。合法报告读回后的标识、结论、说明与缺陷证据保持原值，中文、换行和前后空格不被修剪或改写。

### 提交失败条件（整份失败，不产生部分报告）

下列情况都会使**整份提交**被拒绝：命令以**非零状态退出**，原因写入**标准错误（stderr）**，stdout 没有任何报告片段，报告目录中**不会**出现成功报告（目录原本不存在时也不会被创建）。

1. **checks 记录的产物哈希不匹配。** 任一条记录的 `artifactHash` 不等于本次产物实际哈希即失败，即使其余记录都合法。例如把 `solvency-symbolic` 记录的哈希改成另一个 64 位十六进制串：

   ```text
   audit failed: check for rule solvency-symbolic: artifact hash mismatch
   ```

2. **checks 记录的规则版本不匹配。** 记录的 `version` 必须等于 `rules` 中该规则的版本；声称针对旧版本即失败：

   ```text
   audit failed: check for rule reentrancy-guard: version mismatch
   ```

3. **同一条规则既收到 checks 记录，又在 `invariants` 中收到它所引用的不变式布尔值。** 例如对 `reentrancy-guard` 既给 checks 记录、又给 `"invariants": {"no-reentrant-withdraw": false}`。这是冲突输入，会**整份失败**，不会被解释成“在两种结果之间自动选一个”：

   ```text
   audit failed: rule reentrancy-guard: both a check record and an invariant value are provided
   ```

4. **提交内容含非法字符。** 出于正确性，程序**不会**删除或替换坏字符后继续处理：

   - JSON 字符串（成员名称或任何字符串值，即使只出现在不参与报告的未知扩展成员及其嵌套内容里）含有**非法 UTF-8 字节**；
   - JSON 的 `\uXXXX` Unicode 转义里出现**未配对的高/低代理项**，或**配对顺序错误**（低代理项在前）。

   否则这两类字节都会被解码器静默改写成 U+FFFD：缺陷 `note` 的证据会变成与提交原文不符的文字，`source` 等字段被改写还会改变参与产物哈希计算的内容。命中时整份拒绝，stderr 说明是字符编码还是 Unicode 转义问题并给出字节偏移、行列与 JSON 路径，方便修正原始内容：

   ```text
   audit failed: invalid Unicode escape: unpaired high surrogate escape \uD800 in JSON string value at .checks[0].note (byte offset 535, line 24, column 19)
   audit failed: invalid character encoding: invalid UTF-8 byte 0xff in JSON string value at .artifact.source (byte offset 135, line 6, column 31)
   ```

   合法字符不受影响：中文、换行、前后空格、正确成对的代理转义（如 `😀`）与直接书写的同一字符都可使用，`note`/证据保留解码后的原文，两种写法的产物哈希与报告标识一致；原文中本就存在的 U+FFFD 只是普通字符，`"\\uD800"`（转义反斜线后跟 `uD800`）也只是普通文本，不会被误判。

5. **规则的 `requiresABI` 不是布尔值。** 正式 `requiresABI` 成员（约定拼写，含 Unicode 转义写法）一旦写出，值必须是 `true` 或 `false`；写成 `null`、字符串、数字、对象或数组时整份失败，不会被当成 `false` 继续，即使产物已有 ABI、规则没有收到任何检查结论也一样。错误会点名出错的规则：

   ```text
   audit failed: rule reentrancy-guard: requiresABI must be a boolean
   ```

   省略该成员仍按 `false` 处理；`RequiresABI`、`" requiresABI "` 这类大小写变体或带空格的名称只是扩展信息，其中的 `null` 不触发本错误，也不能替代或挽救正式成员的非法值。

6. **产物字段不是字符串。** 正式 `name`、`abi`、`bytecode`、`source` 成员（约定拼写，含 Unicode 转义写法）一旦在 `artifact` 中写出，值必须是 JSON 字符串；写成 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组时**整份失败**。`null` 在解码时会被静默当成 Go 零值 `""`：产物名称合法、规则数组为空、`source` 写成 `null` 这样的提交会与用户明确提交 `"source": ""` 算出**相同的产物哈希**并照常拿到成功报告，格式错误的内容因此与合法空文本混在一起，无法区分，所以照样拒绝。这条检查只看 JSON 类型，与有没有规则、有没有 checks 记录、规则是否引用该字段无关——没有规则、没有检查记录时也一样执行；它属于**提交格式错误**，不会被记成缺陷、工具缺失或超时。错误会点名具体字段：

   ```text
   audit failed: artifact.source must be a string
   ```

   省略成员仍沿用既有默认值（按空字符串处理），显式空字符串也保留原来的业务判断：缺少或为空的名称仍不能生成报告（`artifact name is required`），`requiresABI` 为真的规则仍要求非空 `abi`，符号规则仍要求非空 `bytecode`；没有这些要求时，合法空文本可以正常使用，且省略与显式 `""` 的产物哈希、报告标识一致。`Name`、`" source "` 这类大小写变体或带空格的名称仍只作为扩展信息忽略，其中的任何值都不能补上缺失的正式字段，也不能挽救正式字段的非法值（无论位于其前还是其后）。合法字符串逐字保留中文、换行与前后空格，`source` 始终是提交的文本内容，不按文件名读取；合法提交的产物哈希、报告标识、规则结论与缺陷证据保持原有结果。

7. **规则定义的文本成员不是字符串。** `rules` 中每条规则已写出的正式 `id`、`kind`、`severity`、`invariant`、`version` 成员（约定拼写，含 Unicode 转义写法），值必须是 JSON 字符串；写成 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组时**整份失败**。`null` 在解码时会被静默当成 Go 零值 `""`：一条 `id` 与 `version` 合法的规则即使把 `kind`、`severity` 或 `invariant` 写成 `null`，也可能通过全部业务检查并生成报告，空掉的定义与用户明确提交空字符串得到的规则定义、报告标识和缺陷绑定完全相同，格式错误因此被洗成了合法提交，所以照样拒绝。这条检查适用于 `rules` 中的**每条规则**，与该规则是否被检查、是否产生缺陷无关；其他规则与 checks 记录合法也不能使提交成功。它属于**规则定义的提交格式错误**，不会被记成缺陷、工具缺失或超时。错误会点名规则在 `rules` 数组中从零开始的位置与出错字段；规则有合法非空 `id` 时同时点名，`id` 自身非法时仍可凭位置定位：

   ```text
   audit failed: rules[1] (rule owner-only-withdraw): severity must be a string
   ```

   省略成员仍沿用既有默认值与必填校验（省略或为空的 `id` 仍报 `rule id is required`，空 `version` 仍报 `version is required`），显式空字符串仍按既有业务规则判断，不会一律要求五个文本非空或限制取值范围；省略与显式 `""` 的报告标识一致。`Kind`、`" invariant "` 这类大小写变体或带空格的名称及未知成员仍只作为扩展信息忽略，其中的 `null` 不触发本错误，合法字符串也不能补上缺失字段或挽救非法正式字段（无论位于其前还是其后）。合法字符串逐字保留中文、换行与前后空格；已有合法提交的产物哈希、报告标识、规则结论与缺陷证据保持原有结果。失败时尚不存在的报告目录不被创建，已有归档保持原样。

此外，记录引用了 `rules` 中不存在的规则、同一规则出现多条 checks 记录、`status` 写成 `未检查` 等未知值（`unknown status …`）、或三种需要说明的状态给了空白说明（`note is required for status …`），同样整份拒绝。

## 比较两份已保存的报告（diff）

`diff` 从**同一个报告目录**中读取两份已经落盘的报告，逐规则比较并输出确定性的比较 JSON（无时间戳，重复比较同一对报告结果逐字节一致）。

```bash
go run ./cmd/contractsentinel diff \
  --store ./reports \
  --before <基准报告 reportId> \
  --after <新报告 reportId>
```

`./cs diff ...` 与上面的 `go run ./cmd/contractsentinel diff ...` 等价，全程离线。

三个参数各选什么：

- **`--store`**：两份报告共同所在的报告目录，与 `audit`、`report` 用的是同一个目录参数。
- **`--before`**：基准报告（当作对照的较早一次审计）；**`--after`**：新报告。
- **比较方向只由两个标识所在的参数位置决定**：工具不按文件时间或归档顺序猜测方向。交换两个参数，所有“新发现/已消除”的方向随之反转。
- 两个参数填的都必须是各自 **`audit` 成功输出（stdout）里的 `reportId`**（随后也可用 `report` 读回确认），**不是产物哈希**。产物哈希相同只说明两份报告审计的产物内容相同，不能拿它当报告标识。
- `diff` 只**读取已保存的结论**做比较：不会重新检查合约，不启动符号执行或模糊测试，不重新解释证据，也不写入或修改报告目录。

如何读这份结果：

- 这条规则的 `change` 是 **“检查状态变化”**，**不是“已消除缺陷”**。基准侧（`before`）原样保留 `发现缺陷` 状态和 finding，finding 的 `evidence` 就是提交时的反例原文；新侧（`after`）只有 `超时` 状态和超时说明，`finding` 为 `null`。两侧结论与原始证据都能在这一个结果条目里直接找到，需要完整报告时再用 `report --id <reportId>` 读回。
- **缺陷总数与变化分类是两类不同字段。** `summary.beforeDefects = 1`、`afterDefects = 0` 只数两侧各自归档的真实 finding 条数（超时、工具缺失不产生 finding）；`newDefects` / `resolvedDefects` 则是对“发生了什么变化”的归类。本例两者都是 0：新报告缺陷数变少，仅仅是因为这次检查**超时、没有得出结论**，并没有一条 `发现缺陷 → 通过` 的迁移。
- **超时不代表检查通过，也不能据此推断缺陷已修复或已消除。** 手头唯一的具体证据仍是基准侧那条重入反例；新侧说明只证明“这次没查完”。`工具缺失`、`未检查` 同理：凡是涉及这几种非正常结论的状态迁移，一律归为“检查状态变化”。
- **只有规则定义完全一致时才比较检查状态**：同一 `ruleId` 的 `version`、`kind`、`severity`、`invariant`、`requiresABI` 全部相同，才可能出现 **`通过 → 发现缺陷` 计为“新发现缺陷”（`newDefects`）**、反向 **`发现缺陷 → 通过` 计为“已消除缺陷”（`resolvedDefects`）**。
- **规则版本或其他定义不同则归为“规则变化”（`changedRules`）**，两侧仍各自保留状态与证据，但不能据此推断修复或新增缺陷。例如把新提交的规则版本改成 `1.4.3`（checks 中的版本同步改为 `1.4.3`），输出就是 `"change": "规则变化"`、`"changedRules": 1`，而 `newDefects` 与 `resolvedDefects` 仍为 0——即使 `beforeDefects` 为 1、`afterDefects` 为 0。

### 比较结果的分类与字段

每个在任一侧出现过的规则标识恰好产生一个 `results` 条目，按 `ruleId` 排序；该侧没有这条规则时对应一侧为 `null`。`change` 沿用既有八类：

| change | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `新发现缺陷` | 定义完全一致，且状态 `通过 → 发现缺陷` |
| `已消除缺陷` | 定义完全一致，且状态 `发现缺陷 → 通过` |
| `检查状态变化` | 定义一致，但状态迁移不属于上面两种（涉及 `超时`、`工具缺失`、`未检查` 等） |
| `检查说明变化` | 状态相同，仅 note 不同 |
| `无变化` | 状态与说明都相同 |
| `新增规则` / `移除规则` | 规则标识只在新侧 / 基准侧出现 |
| `规则变化` | 同名规则的版本或其他定义字段不同，不比较检查状态 |

`before` / `after` 两侧的 `rule` 是该侧完整规则（含 `version`、`status`、`note`）；`finding` 仅在该侧该规则为 `发现缺陷` 时出现，携带当侧归档的 `artifactHash`、`version` 与逐字证据。顶层 `artifactNameChanged` / `artifactHashChanged` 标明两侧产物是否同名同内容。`summary` 中八类计数与逐条 `change` 一一对应且零值也总是出现，`beforeDefects` / `afterDefects` 是两侧缺陷总数。

### diff 失败条件（非零退出，无部分结果，不动归档）

报告标识必须是**恰好 64 位小写十六进制字符串**。下列情况命令都以**非零状态退出**，原因写入 **stderr**，stdout 没有任何比较片段（即使第一份报告已成功读取也不会输出部分结果），报告目录与已有归档保持原样（不创建目录、不修复或改写损坏文件、不留临时文件）：

- 标识格式不合法：

  ```text
  diff failed: invalid report id xyz: want 64 lowercase hex characters
  ```

- 任一报告在目录中不存在（含报告目录本身不存在）：

  ```text
  diff failed: report 0000…0000 not found
  ```

- 任一归档损坏或内容与标识不符：

  ```text
  diff failed: invalid JSON in report 738004a6…0e4e0: invalid character 'b' looking for beginning of object key string
  ```

- 任一归档的规则定义里，正式 `requiresABI` 成员写成了 `null`、字符串、数字、对象或数组等非布尔值：

  ```text
  diff failed: report a6fa091b…3b34 archive is corrupt: rule reentrancy-guard: requiresABI must be a boolean
  ```

  `null` 会被解码静默当成 `false`，损坏归档因此可能与合法归档同标识，甚至被误判为“无变化”；比较前的类型校验会先拒绝整份归档，**任一侧**命中都直接失败，不输出任何比较结果，也不会把被默认成 `false` 的规则拿去判断“规则变化”或“无变化”。省略 `requiresABI` 仍按 `false`，合法 `true` / `false` 的既有比较行为不变。

- 任一归档的规则文本成员（正式的 `id`、`kind`、`severity`、`invariant`、`version`、`status`、`note`）写成了 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组等非字符串值：

  ```text
  diff failed: report a6fa091b…3b34 archive is corrupt: rules[0] (rule owner-only-withdraw): note must be a string
  ```

  `null` 会被解码静默当成空字符串，损坏归档因此可能与合法归档同标识，甚至被误判为“无变化”；比较前的类型校验会先拒绝整份归档，**任一侧**命中都直接失败，不输出任何比较结果，也不会把被默认成空字符串的内容拿去判断“无变化”。省略成员仍按既有默认值处理，已有合法报告的比较分类与统计保持不变。

## 仅提交不变式布尔值（既有用法，保持不变）

在 checks 导入能力之前就存在的用法仍然有效：提交只给 `invariants`（不变式名到布尔值的映射）而不给 `checks`。值为 `false` 的不变式使引用它的规则记为 `发现缺陷` 并生成 finding，证据为 `invariant <不变式名> does not hold`；值为 `true` 记为 `通过`；未出现的规则记为 `未检查`。

```json
{
  "artifact": {"name": "Vault", "abi": "[{\"name\":\"withdraw\"}]", "bytecode": "0x6080", "source": "Vault.sol"},
  "rules": [
    {"id": "reentrancy-guard", "kind": "static", "severity": "high", "invariant": "no-reentrant-withdraw", "requiresABI": false, "version": "1.0.0"}
  ],
  "invariants": {"no-reentrant-withdraw": false}
}
```

checks 导入的补充**不改变**输入格式、报告内容或现有命令的行为：上述提交的字段、生成的报告与报告标识都与以前一致。

314	// ParseAuditInput decodes an audit submission JSON object into domain values.
315	// Invariant values must be JSON booleans; any other type is an error. A formal
316	// requiresABI member on a rule must likewise be a JSON boolean: null or any
317	// non-boolean value rejects the whole submission instead of being read as the
318	// zero value false, while an omitted member still means false. Each formal
319	// rule text member (id, kind, severity, invariant, version) and each formal
320	// artifact member (name, abi, bytecode, source) that is written out must be a
321	// JSON string: null or any non-string value rejects the whole submission
322	// instead of being read as the zero value "", while an omitted member still
323	// takes its default and an explicit empty string keeps the ordinary business
324	// judgement. Any JSON object in the submission that repeats a member name
325	// rejects the whole submission: the decoder keeps only the last value
326	// silently, so a repeated invariant key would choose a conclusion by member
327	// order instead of giving one trustworthy result. A character the decoder
328	// would silently rewrite — an invalid UTF-8 byte, or an unpaired or wrongly
329	// ordered surrogate escape in any member name or string value, including
330	// values nested under unknown extension members — rejects the whole
331	// submission as an input error before any content is hashed, so evidence and
332	// hashes always reflect the submitted bytes rather than a U+FFFD-rewritten
333	// copy. Only the fixed fields under their agreed spelling participate: case
334	// variants and whitespace-padded names are extension data and are ignored, so
335	// they can neither override a formal value nor supply one when the formal
336	// member is missing or unsupported. Invariant names are not fixed fields —
337	// they are user-defined, compared case sensitively and never trimmed.
338	func ParseAuditInput(data []byte) (Artifact, []Rule, map[string]bool, []CheckRecord, error) {
339		if charErr := validateJSONCharacters(data); charErr != nil {
340			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, errInvalid(charErr.Error())
341		}
342		if dup := findDuplicateJSONMember(data); dup != nil {
343			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, errInvalid(duplicateMemberMessage(data, dup))
344		}
345		strict, err := strictSubmissionJSON(data)
346		if err != nil {
347			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, errInvalid("invalid JSON: " + err.Error())
348		}
349		if err := validateFormalCheckStatuses(strict); err != nil {
350			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, err
351		}
352		if err := validateFormalRequiresABI(strict); err != nil {
353			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, err
354		}
355		if err := validateFormalRuleText(strict); err != nil {
356			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, err
357		}
358		if err := validateFormalArtifactFields(strict); err != nil {
359			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, err
360		}
361		var in wireInput
362		if err := json.Unmarshal(strict, &in); err != nil {
363			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, errInvalid("invalid JSON: " + err.Error())
364		}
365		invariants := make(map[string]bool, len(in.Invariants))
366		for key, raw := range in.Invariants {
367			// Only JSON true/false is a conclusion. Unmarshalling directly into a
368			// bool would turn null into the zero value false, which would falsely
369			// record a defect; require the token to be a boolean instead.
370			var token any
371			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &token); err != nil {
372				return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, errInvalid("invariant " + key + " must be a boolean")
373			}
374			holds, ok := token.(bool)
375			if !ok {
376				return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, errInvalid("invariant " + key + " must be a boolean")
377			}
378			invariants[key] = holds
379		}
380		artifact := Artifact{
381			Name:     in.Artifact.Name,
382			ABI:      in.Artifact.ABI,
383			Bytecode: in.Artifact.Bytecode,
384			Source:   in.Artifact.Source,
385		}
386		rules := make([]Rule, 0, len(in.Rules))
387		for _, wr := range in.Rules {
388			rules = append(rules, Rule{
389				ID:          wr.ID,
390				Kind:        wr.Kind,
391				Severity:    wr.Severity,
392				Invariant:   wr.Invariant,
393				RequiresABI: wr.RequiresABI,
394				Version:     wr.Version,
395			})
396		}
397		checks := make([]CheckRecord, 0, len(in.Checks))
398		for _, wc := range in.Checks {
399			checks = append(checks, CheckRecord{
400				ArtifactHash: wc.ArtifactHash,
401				RuleID:       wc.RuleID,
402				Version:      wc.Version,
403				Status:       wc.Status,
404				Note:         wc.Note,
405			})
406		}
407		return artifact, rules, invariants, checks, nil
408	}
409	
410	// ArtifactHash computes the content hash of an artifact. Only the raw ABI,
411	// bytecode and source strings contribute; field boundaries are explicit
412	// (length-prefixed) so that different splits never collide. The source is
413	// hashed as a field value, never read from disk, and the name does not
414	// participate.
415	func ArtifactHash(a Artifact) string {
416		h := sha256.New()
417		h.Write([]byte("contractsentinel-artifact-v1\n"))
418		for _, field := range []string{a.ABI, a.Bytecode, a.Source} {
419			fmt.Fprintf(h, "%d\n", len(field))
420			h.Write([]byte(field))
421		}
422		sum := h.Sum(nil)
423		return hex.EncodeToString(sum)
424	}
425	
426	// validCheckStatus reports whether status is one of the four recorded check
427	// conclusions.
428	func validCheckStatus(status string) bool {
429		switch status {
430		case StatusPass, StatusDefect, StatusToolMissing, StatusTimeout:
431			return true
432		}
433		return false
434	}
435	
436	// BuildReport evaluates rules against the artifact and invariant values and
437	// imported check records and produces the report to persist. Insufficient
438	// inputs (missing ABI for a rule that requires it, missing bytecode for a
439	// symbolic rule) fail the whole submission and are never recorded as defects.
440	// Imported checks are validated as a whole: unknown rules, duplicate records,
441	// unknown statuses, missing notes, hash or version mismatches, and a rule
442	// receiving both a check record and an invariant boolean all reject the
443	// submission without producing a report.
444	func BuildReport(artifact Artifact, rules []Rule, invariants map[string]bool, checks []CheckRecord) (Report, error) {
445		if artifact.Name == "" {
446			return Report{}, errInvalid("artifact name is required")
447		}
448		hash := ArtifactHash(artifact)
449		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(rules))
450		ruleByID := make(map[string]Rule, len(rules))
451		for _, rule := range rules {
452			if rule.ID == "" {
453				return Report{}, errInvalid("rule id is required")
454			}
455			if rule.Version == "" {
456				return Report{}, errInvalid("rule " + rule.ID + " version is required")
457			}
458			if seen[rule.ID] {
459				return Report{}, errInvalid("duplicate rule id " + rule.ID)
460			}
461			seen[rule.ID] = true
462			ruleByID[rule.ID] = rule
463			if rule.RequiresABI && artifact.ABI == "" {
464				return Report{}, errInvalid("rule " + rule.ID + " requires an ABI")
465			}
466			if rule.Kind == "symbolic" && artifact.Bytecode == "" {
467				return Report{}, errInvalid("symbolic rule " + rule.ID + " requires bytecode")
468			}
469		}
470		checkByRule := make(map[string]CheckRecord, len(checks))
471		for _, check := range checks {
472			if check.RuleID == "" {
473				return Report{}, errInvalid("check rule id is required")
474			}
475			rule, ok := ruleByID[check.RuleID]
476			if !ok {
477				return Report{}, errInvalid("check for rule " + check.RuleID + ": unknown rule")
478			}
479			if _, dup := checkByRule[check.RuleID]; dup {
480				return Report{}, errInvalid("duplicate check for rule " + check.RuleID)
481			}
482			if check.ArtifactHash != hash {
483				return Report{}, errInvalid("check for rule " + check.RuleID + ": artifact hash mismatch")
484			}
485			if check.Version != rule.Version {
486				return Report{}, errInvalid("check for rule " + check.RuleID + ": version mismatch")
487			}
488			if !validCheckStatus(check.Status) {
489				return Report{}, errInvalid("check for rule " + check.RuleID + ": unknown status " + check.Status)
490			}
491			if check.Status != StatusPass && strings.TrimSpace(check.Note) == "" {
492				return Report{}, errInvalid("check for rule " + check.RuleID + ": note is required for status " + check.Status)
493			}
494			if _, hasInvariant := invariants[rule.Invariant]; hasInvariant {
495				return Report{}, errInvalid("rule " + check.RuleID + ": both a check record and an invariant value are provided")
496			}
497			checkByRule[check.RuleID] = check
498		}
499		report := Report{
500			Artifact: ReportArtifact{Name: artifact.Name, Hash: hash},
501			Rules:    []ReportRule{},
502			Findings: []ReportFinding{},
503		}
504		for _, rule := range rules {
505			status := StatusUnchecked
506			note := ""
507			if check, ok := checkByRule[rule.ID]; ok {
508				status = check.Status
509				note = check.Note
510			} else {
511				// No imported check: the invariant booleans decide. The verdict
512				// interpretation is shared with the finding-list path in Run.
513				switch checkInvariant(rule, invariants) {
514				case invariantHolds:
515					status = StatusPass
516				case invariantViolated:
517					status = StatusDefect
518				}
519			}
520			report.Rules = append(report.Rules, ReportRule{
521				ID:          rule.ID,
522				Kind:        rule.Kind,
523				Severity:    rule.Severity,
524				Invariant:   rule.Invariant,
525				RequiresABI: rule.RequiresABI,
526				Version:     rule.Version,
527				Status:      status,
528				Note:        note,
529			})
530			if status == StatusDefect {
531				evidence := note
532				if evidence == "" {
533					evidence = invariantEvidence(rule.Invariant)
534				}
535				report.Findings = append(report.Findings, ReportFinding{
536					ArtifactHash: hash,
537					RuleID:       rule.ID,
538					Version:      rule.Version,
539					Severity:     rule.Severity,
540					Invariant:    rule.Invariant,
541					Evidence:     evidence,
542				})
543			}
544		}
545		report.ReportID = ReportID(report)
546		return report, nil
547	}

549	// canonicalReport is the deterministic content a report id is computed from.
550	// The rules and findings are the report's own ReportRule and ReportFinding
551	// values: their stored JSON fields are exactly the content the id binds, so
552	// the id form reuses the one field representation instead of maintaining a
553	// parallel copy that every field change would have to be mirrored into. The
554	// rule note keeps its omitempty behaviour, so a note omitted and a note
555	// written as an empty string hash alike and reports built only from invariant
556	// booleans keep their original ids.
557	type canonicalReport struct {
558		ArtifactHash string          `json:"artifactHash"`
559		Name         string          `json:"name"`
560		Rules        []ReportRule    `json:"rules"`
561		Findings     []ReportFinding `json:"findings"`
562	}
563	
564	// canonicalize renders a report into its order-independent form. The rule and
565	// finding slices are copied before sorting, so computing an id never reorders
566	// the report itself: a saved report keeps the submission order and a loaded
567	// report keeps the archive order.
568	func canonicalize(report Report) canonicalReport {
569		cr := canonicalReport{
570			ArtifactHash: report.Artifact.Hash,
571			Name:         report.Artifact.Name,
572		}
573		cr.Rules = append(cr.Rules, report.Rules...)
574		sort.Slice(cr.Rules, func(i, j int) bool { return cr.Rules[i].ID < cr.Rules[j].ID })
575		cr.Findings = append(cr.Findings, report.Findings...)
576		sort.Slice(cr.Findings, func(i, j int) bool { return cr.Findings[i].RuleID < cr.Findings[j].RuleID })
577		return cr
578	}

580	// ReportID returns the content-addressed identifier of a report. The id binds
581	// the artifact hash, name, complete rule definitions, the invariant value
582	// used by each rule (unchecked and explicit pass are distinct), and the
583	// findings. Rule order, invariant key order and unrelated invariant keys do
584	// not influence it.
585	func ReportID(r Report) string {
586		data, err := json.Marshal(canonicalize(r))
587		if err != nil {
588			panic(err) // canonical values are all strings and bools
589		}
590		sum := sha256.Sum256(data)
591		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
592	}

594	// validateReport checks every archive legality condition against r. It is the
595	// single definition of a legal report: the id and artifact hash are 64
596	// lowercase hex characters, the id matches the content, the artifact name is
597	// present, rule ids are present and unique with non-empty versions, statuses
598	// use the five recorded values, tool-missing and timeout notes are
599	// non-blank, and 发现缺陷 rules correspond one-to-one with findings whose
600	// artifact hash, version, severity, invariant and evidence match the rule.
601	// The same conditions apply to submissions and to stored archives: a
602	// recomputed id never makes an invalid report legal. fail is errInvalid for
603	// submissions and errCorrupt for stored archives.
604	func validateReport(r Report, fail func(string) error) error {
605		if !validReportID(r.ReportID) {
606			return fail("report id " + r.ReportID + " is not a 64-character lowercase hex string")
607		}
608		if r.Artifact.Name == "" {
609			return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " artifact name is required")
610		}
611		if !validReportID(r.Artifact.Hash) {
612			return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " artifact hash is not a 64-character lowercase hex string")
613		}
614		if ReportID(r) != r.ReportID {
615			return fail("report content does not match id " + r.ReportID)
616		}
617		seenRule := make(map[string]bool, len(r.Rules))
618		defectByID := make(map[string]ReportRule)
619		for _, rule := range r.Rules {
620			if rule.ID == "" {
621				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " has a rule with an empty id")
622			}
623			if seenRule[rule.ID] {
624				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " has duplicate rule id " + rule.ID)
625			}
626			seenRule[rule.ID] = true
627			if rule.Version == "" {
628				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " rule " + rule.ID + " has an empty version")
629			}
630			switch rule.Status {
631			case StatusUnchecked, StatusPass, StatusDefect, StatusToolMissing, StatusTimeout:
632			default:
633				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " rule " + rule.ID + " has unknown status " + rule.Status)
634			}
635			if (rule.Status == StatusToolMissing || rule.Status == StatusTimeout) && strings.TrimSpace(rule.Note) == "" {
636				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " rule " + rule.ID + " status " + rule.Status + " has no note")
637			}
638			if rule.Status == StatusDefect {
639				defectByID[rule.ID] = rule
640			}
641		}
642		seenFinding := make(map[string]bool, len(r.Findings))
643		for _, f := range r.Findings {
644			if f.RuleID == "" {
645				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " has a finding with an empty rule id")
646			}
647			rule, ok := defectByID[f.RuleID]
648			if !ok {
649				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " does not match a 发现缺陷 rule")
650			}
651			if seenFinding[f.RuleID] {
652				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " has a duplicate finding for rule " + f.RuleID)
653			}
654			seenFinding[f.RuleID] = true
655			if f.ArtifactHash != r.Artifact.Hash {
656				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has artifact hash " + f.ArtifactHash + ", want " + r.Artifact.Hash)
657			}
658			if f.Version != rule.Version {
659				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has version " + f.Version + ", want " + rule.Version)
660			}
661			if f.Severity != rule.Severity {
662				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has severity " + f.Severity + ", want " + rule.Severity)
663			}
664			if f.Invariant != rule.Invariant {
665				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has invariant " + f.Invariant + ", want " + rule.Invariant)
666			}
667			wantEvidence := rule.Note
668			if wantEvidence == "" {
669				wantEvidence = invariantEvidence(rule.Invariant)
670			}
671			if f.Evidence != wantEvidence {
672				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has evidence " + f.Evidence + ", want " + wantEvidence)
673			}
674		}
675		for id := range defectByID {
676			if !seenFinding[id] {
677				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " defect rule " + id + " has no finding")
678			}
679		}
680		return nil
681	}

693	// firstInvalidUTF8ByteInString returns the first byte that is not valid UTF-8
694	// inside s. A Go string can carry any bytes, including bytes no JSON text may
695	// contain: json.Marshal (and therefore the canonical marshalling inside
696	// ReportID) silently replaces such a byte with U+FFFD instead of failing, so
697	// neither the id/content check nor the archive round trip can see it.
698	func firstInvalidUTF8ByteInString(s string) (byte, bool) {
699		for i := 0; i < len(s); {
700			r, size := utf8.DecodeRuneInString(s[i:])
701			if r == utf8.RuneError && size == 1 {
702				return s[i], true
703			}
704			i += size
705		}
706		return 0, false
707	}

709	// validateSubmittedText is the in-memory counterpart of the JSON character
710	// gates in ParseAuditInput and loadStoredReport. SaveReport accepts a Report
711	// built directly by a Go caller, whose strings never passed through JSON
712	// decoding; encoding/json marshals such a value without an error while
713	// replacing every invalid UTF-8 byte with U+FFFD, and ReportID computes from
714	// the same rewritten canonical form, so the recomputed id and the
715	// rule/finding correspondence would all match an archive whose text no
716	// longer equals what the caller handed over. Every caller-supplied string is
717	// therefore checked on the raw object — reportId, artifact name and hash,
718	// each rule definition field and status note, and each finding binding field
719	// and evidence — independently of which rules produced defects and of
720	// whether the report carries any finding at all. The rejection is an input
721	// error naming the exact field, with the array position of rules and
722	// findings, and it runs before any filesystem operation.
723	func validateSubmittedText(r Report) error {
724		check := func(field, value string) error {
725			if b, bad := firstInvalidUTF8ByteInString(value); bad {
726				return errInvalid(fmt.Sprintf("invalid UTF-8 byte 0x%02x in report field %s", b, field))
727			}
728			return nil
729		}
730		if err := check("reportId", r.ReportID); err != nil {
731			return err
732		}
733		if err := check("artifact.name", r.Artifact.Name); err != nil {
734			return err
735		}
736		if err := check("artifact.hash", r.Artifact.Hash); err != nil {
737			return err
738		}
739		ruleFields := []string{"id", "kind", "severity", "invariant", "version", "status", "note"}
740		for i, rule := range r.Rules {
741			values := []string{rule.ID, rule.Kind, rule.Severity, rule.Invariant, rule.Version, rule.Status, rule.Note}
742			for j, value := range values {
743				if err := check(fmt.Sprintf("rules[%d].%s", i, ruleFields[j]), value); err != nil {
744					return err
745				}
746			}
747		}
748		findingFields := []string{"artifactHash", "ruleId", "version", "severity", "invariant", "evidence"}
749		for i, finding := range r.Findings {
750			values := []string{finding.ArtifactHash, finding.RuleID, finding.Version, finding.Severity, finding.Invariant, finding.Evidence}
751			for j, value := range values {
752				if err := check(fmt.Sprintf("findings[%d].%s", i, findingFields[j]), value); err != nil {
753					return err
754				}
755			}
756		}
757		return nil
758	}

802	// validateArchiveRuleFields is the read-side counterpart of the submission
803	// gate in validateFormalRequiresABI. A ReportRule's typed members are Go
804	// bool/string fields, so decoding the strict archive straight into Report
805	// turns a formal null member into the zero value false or "": an archive that
806	// wrote "requiresABI":null, or "note":null on a passing rule without a note,
807	// would read byte-for-byte like one that omitted the member, the recomputed
808	// id and the rule/finding correspondence would all pass on that laundered
809	// value, and a diff could even compare the rule as unchanged. The shared
810	// checkRuleFieldTypes gate therefore inspects each written formal member's
811	// raw JSON token before that decoding happens. null or any other
812	// non-required type makes the whole archive corrupt, independently of the
813	// rule's check status and of whether it has a finding — the offending rule is
814	// never skipped and no partial report is returned. An omitted member still
815	// decodes to the zero value and an explicit empty string is still judged by
816	// the ordinary business rules: the string gate is about the JSON type alone,
817	// not about requiring text to be non-empty. The strict rewrite dropped
818	// extension members, so a case-variant or whitespace-padded name is invisible
819	// here: a correctly typed value it carries neither supplies nor rescues the
820	// formal value, and a null it carries never reaches this gate. locate renders
821	// the rule locator in the wording each gate historically used, and every
822	// error names the requested report id and is classified as archive
823	// corruption.
824	func validateArchiveRuleFields(strict []byte, id string, checks []ruleFieldTypeCheck,
825		locate func(int, map[string]json.RawMessage) string) error {
826		return checkRuleFieldTypes(strict, checks, ruleFieldTypeHooks{
827			locate: locate,
828			invalidJSON: func(err error) error {
829				return errCorrupt("invalid JSON in report " + id + ": " + err.Error())
830			},
831			reject: func(where, field string, typ ruleFieldType) error {
832				return errCorrupt("report " + id + " archive is corrupt: " + where + ": " + field + " " + typ.requirement())
833			},
834		})
835	}

837	// archiveRuleLocator names a rule in an archive error by its formal id
838	// ("rule r-bad"), falling back to "rule" when the id is missing, empty or not
839	// itself a legal string. It deliberately carries no rules-array position.
840	func archiveRuleLocator(_ int, rule map[string]json.RawMessage) string {
841		if ruleID := formalRuleID(rule); ruleID != "" {
842			return "rule " + ruleID
843		}
844		return "rule"

881	// loadStoredReport parses archive bytes for id and fully validates them.
882	func loadStoredReport(data []byte, id string) (Report, error) {
883		// Read-side counterpart of the submission character gate in
884		// ParseAuditInput. As with a repeated member, json.Unmarshal silently
885		// rewrites an invalid UTF-8 byte and an unpaired or wrongly ordered
886		// surrogate escape into U+FFFD, so an archive whose note and evidence both
887		// carried the substitution character could have those two spots changed to
888		// lone surrogate escapes and still decode to byte-identical content: the
889		// recomputed id and the rule/finding evidence comparison would then pass on
890		// the rewritten copy. Every raw string literal is checked first — member
891		// names and values, at every depth, inside unknown extension members too —
892		// and the whole archive is corrupt when any character is illegal, whatever
893		// id the rewritten content would compute.
894		if charErr := validateJSONCharacters(data); charErr != nil {
895			return Report{}, characterArchiveError(id, charErr)
896		}
897		// Read-side counterpart of the submission check: json.Unmarshal silently
898		// keeps the last value for a repeated member, so an archive that writes a
899		// rule status as 发现缺陷 and then 通过 would decode to whichever came
900		// last. The recomputed id and the rule/finding correspondence all operate
901		// on that last-wins value and could therefore pass, accepting an archive
902		// with two conflicting conclusions. Any repeated member in any object
903		// makes the archive corrupt, regardless of the last value.
904		if dup := findDuplicateJSONMember(data); dup != nil {
905			return Report{}, duplicateArchiveError(id, data, dup)
906		}
907		strict, err := strictReportJSON(data)
908		if err != nil {
909			return Report{}, errCorrupt("invalid JSON in report " + id + ": " + err.Error())
910		}
911		// Check the formal requiresABI member against its raw JSON token before
912		// decoding into the Go bool below; otherwise a null value would silently
913		// become the zero value false and could pass every later check, including
914		// the content id, as if the archive had explicitly said false.
915		if err := validateArchiveRequiresABI(strict, id); err != nil {
916			return Report{}, err
917		}
918		// Same laundering hazard for the rule text fields: decoding into a Go
919		// string turns a formal null member into "", so an archive that wrote
920		// "note":null on a note-less passing rule would pass every later check,
921		// including the content id, as if the member had been omitted. Check the
922		// raw JSON token of every written formal text member before decoding.
923		if err := validateArchiveRuleText(strict, id); err != nil {
924			return Report{}, err
925		}
926		var r Report
927		if err := json.Unmarshal(strict, &r); err != nil {
928			return Report{}, errCorrupt("invalid JSON in report " + id + ": " + err.Error())
929		}
930		if r.ReportID != id {
931			return Report{}, errCorrupt("report id " + r.ReportID + " does not match requested id " + id)
932		}
933		if err := validStoredReport(r); err != nil {
934			return Report{}, err
935		}
936		return r, nil
937	}

939	// saveReportHook, when set, is invoked after the archive existence check and
940	// before the atomic publish. It lets tests simulate another process racing to
941	// claim the same report id.
942	var saveReportHook func(finalPath string)
943	
944	// SaveReport persists a report under the store directory. The store is safe
945	// for concurrent writers: identical reports share one file and all
946	// submissions succeed, different reports never overwrite each other, and
947	// readers only ever observe complete files. A submission is fully validated
948	// before any store operation, so an invalid report creates no store and no
949	// files. Every string in a directly constructed report must be valid UTF-8:
950	// json.Marshal would otherwise rewrite an invalid byte to U+FFFD while the
951	// content-addressed id matched the rewritten copy, reporting success for an
952	// archive whose text differs from the caller's; such a report is rejected as
953	// an input error before the store directory is touched. A pre-existing file
954	// with the same id must be a valid archive of the same report; a corrupted
955	// archive makes the submission fail while keeping the original file, even
956	// when the corruption appears only during the save. The first successfully
957	// archived bytes are never replaced by later submissions.
958	func SaveReport(dir string, r Report) error {
959		if err := validateSubmittedText(r); err != nil {
960			return err
961		}
962		if err := validSubmittedReport(r); err != nil {
963			return err
964		}
965		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
966			return err
967		}
968		finalPath := filepath.Join(dir, r.ReportID+".json")
969		if existing, err := os.ReadFile(finalPath); err == nil {
970			if _, err := loadStoredReport(existing, r.ReportID); err != nil {
971				return err
972			}
973			return nil
974		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
975			return err
976		}
977		data, err := json.Marshal(r)
978		if err != nil {
979			return err
980		}
981		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, ".report-*.tmp")
982		if err != nil {
983			return err
984		}
985		tmpPath := tmp.Name()
986		cleanup := func() { os.Remove(tmpPath) }
987		if _, err := tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
988			tmp.Close()
989			cleanup()
990			return err
991		}
992		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
993			tmp.Close()
994			cleanup()
995			return err
996		}
997		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
998			cleanup()
999			return err
1000		}
1001		if saveReportHook != nil {
1002			saveReportHook(finalPath)
1003		}
1004		if err := os.Link(tmpPath, finalPath); err != nil {
1005			cleanup()
1006			if os.IsExist(err) {
1007				existing, readErr := os.ReadFile(finalPath)
1008				if readErr != nil {
1009					return readErr
1010				}
1011				if _, err := loadStoredReport(existing, r.ReportID); err != nil {
1012					return err
1013				}
1014				return nil
1015			}
1016			return err
1017		}
1018		cleanup()
1019		return nil
1020	}

6	import "encoding/json"
